name: Battery cell
brief: MK-147 Battery cell: the pickup that powers doors and the zapper's charger. Round 2, matched to the Midjourney pick: a chunky cube with dark bumper corners, off-white side panels, a carry handle, an orange window on its flank and three green charge bars behind a dark grille (diegetic: the bars say how full it is).

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
